d: India’s carbon emissions and its ongoing border tensions with China raise questions about global accountability and regional security. At the Berlin Global Dialogue, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal challenged developed nations over historical emissions, per-capita carbon footprints and climate finance, highlighting the debate over climate justice and developing countries’ responsibilities.
